paragraph__1.content: Welcome to Aurelia. These steps make your store match the demo:

paragraph__3.content: Online Store › Navigation: build a Main menu (e.g. Shop, Collections, New arrivals, Best sellers) and footer menus (Shop, About, Help, Customer). Nested links become dropdowns or a mega menu.

paragraph__5.content: Settings › Custom data › Products: add the optional metafields custom.material, custom.metal_type, custom.metal_color, custom.stone_type, custom.stone_size, custom.carat, custom.weight, custom.dimensions, custom.finish, custom.plating, custom.hypoallergenic, custom.water_resistance, custom.care, custom.shipping_note and custom.product_story. Empty fields are hidden automatically.

paragraph__7.content: Install Shopify Search & Discovery to add collection filters (category, metal, stone, price, availability) and complementary products for 'Style it with'.

paragraph__9.content: Install a reviews app (Judge.me, Okendo, Shopify Product Reviews…). Ratings appear on cards automatically; add the app block to the Reviews section on product pages.
